commands.start: Start the bot and open main menu

menu.placeholder: Describe what you are looking for or use the menu…

start.choose_language: 🌐 Выберите язык / Choose your language / Scegli la lingua:
start.welcome: 👋 Welcome to DOMIK{name}! Tell me in your own words what kind of home you are looking for (district, budget, rooms, stay period), or use the menu buttons below.
start.help: ℹ️ How to use DOMIK bot: • Describe your requirements in chat — our AI assistant will find matching properties and answer rental questions. • Tap 🔍 Find property for a step-by-step filter wizard. • On any property card tap 📅 Book a viewing to pick a date and time. • In 📅 My viewings you can reschedule, notify that you are running late, or cancel. • Send /reset to clear the AI conversation history.

ai.fallback: 🤖 The AI assistant is temporarily unavailable. Please use 🔍 Find property or contact an operator.
ai.reset: 🧹 Conversation history cleared. Tell me what kind of home you are looking for!
ai.text_only: Please send a text message or choose an option from the menu.
